title: Front-end inventory, per stack per language
scope: Every phonemiser, polyphone disambiguator, stress/accent marker, punctuation restorer, ITN and text normaliser each stack needs.
headline: The named ~102,000,000 g2pW hazard is NOT what kills Q and F. A punctuation restorer is, and it is cheaper AND unavoidable. OmniASR-CTC-300M's tokenizer is character-level with ZERO punctuation tokens, so a punctuation source is architecturally REQUIRED for Q and F; the cheapest measured five-language neural restorer is 58,199,117, which exceeds Q's headroom (35,517,077) and F's (24,367,893). Both survive only by delegating punctuation and ITN to the backbone LLM at zero additional parameters.

**Section 2.2 is REFUTED.** It states the stress marker is 'bundled inside Silero TTS as silero_stress' and that this is why L6's bound is 100,000,000 rather than 20,000,000. It is NOT bundled: the packaged module's constructor takes accentor=None and the archive contains no accentor tensors. L needs an external RU stress source.

structural_findings.finding: facebook/omniASR-CTC-300M cannot emit punctuation. Its sentencepiece tokenizer is character-level and contains ZERO punctuation tokens.
structural_findings.evidence: Exhaustive byte scan of the 87,562 B omniASR_tokenizer.model: 0 occurrences of '.', ',', '?', '!', ';', ':'. Digits and CJK/Cyrillic/Greek/Khmer characters ARE present, confirming the scan is sound rather than a decode failure.
structural_findings.consequence: Section 2.4a's 'more likely to be non-zero' understates this. The row is mandatory.
structural_findings.only_affordable_resolution: Delegate to the backbone LLM (0 params). Must be a build-time assertion.

structural_findings.finding: D's zh/en punctuation and ITN row is CLOSED at zero parameters. SenseVoiceSmall does it natively via use_itn.
structural_findings.evidence: FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall model card, verbatim: 'use_itn: Whether the output result includes punctuation and inverse text normalization.'
structural_findings.consequence: Section 2.3 row D11 was UNKNOWN for all five languages. It is now 0 for zh/en and UNKNOWN only for es/fr/ru (D11b).

structural_findings.finding: Section 2.2's claim that the RU stress marker is 'bundled inside Silero TTS as silero_stress' is REFUTED.
structural_findings.evidence: The v5_cis_base torch.package archive's module constructor takes accentor=None, and no accentor tensors exist among its 317 storages.
structural_findings.consequence: The stated justification for L6's 100,000,000 bound (rather than 20,000,000) does not hold. The measured count is 22,850,584 and L needs a SEPARATE external RU stress row.

structural_findings.finding: g2pM (row L7) may be redundant in L. Magpie's model_config.yaml declares its own ChinesePhonemesTokenizer + ChineseG2p (rule-based pinyin) for the zh route.
structural_findings.consequence: If the Magpie zh route uses its built-in G2P, L7's 401,548 is a duplicate.
structural_findings.closing_experiment: Check which zh G2P the shipped Magpie route calls.

structural_findings.finding: D and M each DELETE the external G2P ladder entirely -- D for en/es/fr/ru via Supertonic's built-in front end, M for all five via MOSS's SentencePiece-only design.
structural_findings.consequence: Section 2.4's note that this is 'one of the few real arguments for M' is supported by the inventory: M's front-end row count is the smallest of any stack, and its only open row is punctuation.

structural_findings.finding: eSpeak NG linkage is confirmed per voice, not inferred. Every Piper voice config audited declares phoneme_type=espeak.
structural_findings.consequence: The GPL-3.0 linkage flag applies to H, Q and F with EXACT provenance. A licence row, not a parameter row.

the_comparison_was_not_like_for_like.observation: LANE_A_LEDGER.md notes that Stack D carried no front-end row at all while L carried g2pM. That is now resolved in both directions.
the_comparison_was_not_like_for_like.D: D8/D9/D10 are genuinely 0 (pypinyin, eSpeak ru rules, Supertonic built-in) and D11 is 0 for zh/en. D's front end is genuinely almost free -- the low row count reflected reality, not an omission.
the_comparison_was_not_like_for_like.L: L's g2pM row may be redundant against Magpie's built-in ChineseG2p (FE-4), and L is MISSING an RU stress row that section 2.2 wrongly believed was bundled (FE-3).
the_comparison_was_not_like_for_like.conclusion: D's front end is cheaper than L's, not less well documented. The like-for-like comparison favours D.
